gen-gf-battambang-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans has a generous x-height and curves that open wide at both ends, with no thick-to-thin shifts at all. And Battambang is the showier one, its compressed ascenders and open-jawed curves giving a headline some expressive bite that the body happily leaves alone.
gen-gf-battambang-fs-merriweather-sans: Battambang's open-jawed curves and compressed ascenders give it a distinctive, slightly squeezed personality. Merriweather Sans answers with tall, sturdy lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, so the pair's strongest quality is a showy top over a very legible base.
gen-gf-battambang-fs-public-sans: Expressive is the mood up top, with Battambang's compressed ascenders and open jaws on every curve. Public Sans settles into a hefty lowercase with broad counters, which makes a long stretch of text feel sturdy and trustworthy.
gen-gf-battambang-fs-supreme: Battambang's compressed ascenders and open-jawed curves are what you notice first. Supreme holds a thick, heavy band of text with letters that stay held open, so shrinking the heading would lose its character while the body keeps its crisp footing.
gen-gf-battambang-general-sans: Tight, quirky, and a bit rope-like up top. General Sans runs with steady pressure and a tall x-height that fills the line, so a longer read glides around smooth bends without a single swollen join.
gen-gf-battambang-manrope: Approachable is the word for Manrope, which leaves a bright gap at every curve and keeps its line to one width. And Battambang's compressed ascenders and open jaws add the expressive spark, so give it room to stand out above the quieter text.
gen-gf-battambang-montserrat: Battambang brings compressed ascenders and open-jawed curves, like twine pressed flat. Montserrat follows with oversized e and a counters and a line that glides like wire, so the page moves from rough rope to drafting pen.
gen-gf-battambang-satoshi: Satoshi reads tall and friendly, with a soaring x-height and an e that never looks squeezed shut. But Battambang earns its place big and brief, where its compressed ascenders and rope-like strokes can show off.
gen-gf-battambang-switzer: Distinctive describes Battambang, with its compressed ascenders and open jaws on every curve. Switzer follows in tubular, wire-like letters with a tall waist line and c tips that never creep shut, so a longer read feels like bent copper pipe, clean and unhurried.
gen-gf-battambang-work-sans: Work Sans reads modern and level, with a high mean line. Its unshaded strokes and joins as thick as the stems keep a long page moving easily beneath Battambang's expressive, compressed headings.
